_comment: The crease cable of Section 6.4.1, lifted from src/best_fit_stretch_factors_cable.cpp so the imperfection study and the case study use one definition. 19 vertices, 18 segments. EA = 157000 N is a 1 mm steel cable. L_rest is omitted: the solver takes the geometric length on the rest mesh, and the rest-length tolerance is applied by scaling that.
